text:
natalie: Quick heads up — running the new generator sample app I saw goroutines pile up when a stream is cancelled during token refresh. repro: run sampleapp with short token TTL and spam restart. logs show "auth: token refresh in progress" loop and leak.
ajay: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro and logs?
natalie: sure — here's the handler snippet from sampleapp:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
stream, err := client.GenerateStream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
go func() {
  for { tok, err := stream.Recv(); if err != nil { break } process(tok) }
}()
// cancel triggered by signal
cancel()
```
then logs show `goroutine` stuck in auth/refresh path.
sara: are you using the example auth provider from docs (ephemeral tokens)?
natalie: yes, the demo provider returns expiring tokens and refresh happens lazily when a 401 occurs mid-stream.
michael: is this potentially a parity issue with python SDK? python handles refresh sync in handshake IIRC.
ajay: thinking out loud: two separate problems — (1) generator stream loop doesn't propagate transient auth errors properly to caller, leaving receiver goroutine waiting; (2) auth refresh does blocking network call without observing ctx cancellation.
sara: my suggestion: make auth refresh cancellable and add a non-blocking hook in stream receiver to bail when ctx.Done(). Also wrap refresh in `select { case <-ctx.Done(): return ctx.Err() default: }` + use a refresh queue so only one goroutine refreshes token for many streams.
natalie: that sounds reasonable. sampleapp currently does naive `authClient.Refresh()` with no ctx passed.
ajay: proposal PR outline: (a) change Auth.Refresh to accept context, (b) stream.Recv should select on ctx.Done and internal recv channel, and (c) auth middleware uses singleflight-like refresher so concurrent 401s coalesce. I'll draft.
michael: agree. also good to document the recommended pattern in devex sample: `defer cancel()` and show `recvLoop` that exits cleanly on ctx.Done.
sara: small nit — add metrics for refresh failures and blocked refresh duration so we can catch regressions in console.
devex-bot: created issue #452: "streaming: cancel + token-refresh goroutine leak" (assigned ajay).
ajay: i'll open a draft PR with tests and a tiny sampleapp update. assigning to @sara for review when ready.
natalie: thanks — i'll try the draft and run stress tests across clusters and post results here.
michael: :thumbsup:
